tasks.title: Conversation #64
tasks.transcript:
Man: Have you tried using that new app our physics professor mentioned? I was going to download it, but then I figured I wouldn't have time to figure out how to use it.
Woman: : I can totally show you. It's not that bad, and it's been helpful for our last couple of homework assignments.
Man: Great, I was planning to go to the tutoring canter for extra help.
Woman: You probably won't need to now. Here, I'll show you were to get it. And I have the code the professor gave us for the free trial.
Man: I actually have that.

questions.stem: Why did the man NOT download an app?

options.A: He did not realize it was required for class.
options.B: He did not have a code he needed.
options.C: He worried it would be difficult to learn.
options.D: He thought it was too expensive.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 男士为什么没有下载那个 App？ 定位原文: Man: "I was going to download it, but then I figured I wouldn't have time to figure out how to use it." 选项分析: A. He did not realize it was required for class. (他没意识到这是课程要求的。) - 错误。对话中提到这是教授推荐的，且男士知道这个 App。 B. He did not have a code he needed. (他没有需要的兑换码。) - 错误。对话最后男士明确说 "I actually have that"（其实我有那个码）。 C. He worried it would be difficult to learn. (他担心学起来很难/很费时。) - 正确。男士说"wouldn't have time to figure out how to use it"，暗示他认为学习使用这个 App 需要花费大量时间，即担心上手难度大。 D. He thought it was too expensive. (他觉得太贵了。) - 错误。对话中提到了 "free trial"（免费试用），并未提及价格顾虑。

questions.stem: Why does the man mention a tutoring center?
questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 男士为什么要提到辅导中心（tutoring center）？ 定位原文: Man: "Great, I was planning to go to the tutoring center for extra help." 选项分析: A. To share his original plan (为了分享他原本的计划) - 正确。男士使用过去进行时 "was planning to"，表明在女士提出帮忙之前，这是他原本的打算，现在因为有了女士的帮助可能不再需要去了。 B. To describe his new job (为了描述他的新工作) - 错误。辅导中心是学生寻求帮助的地方，不是工作地点。 C. To explain his problem (为了解释他的问题) - 错误。他的问题是物理作业难，辅导中心是解决方案，不是问题本身。 D. To make a recommendation (为了给出一个推荐) - 错误。他是陈述自己的计划，而不是建议女士去。
